'''Gravlex Med''' was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. With an above-average [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]], the planet's native [[Species/Legends|species]], the [[Anx/Legends|Anx]], had a stooped stature and other species found the world uninhabitable. Gravlex Med quickly became the heart of [[Anx Space]] as the spacefaring species expanded their borders throughout the [[Raioballo sector/Legends|Raioballo sector]]. During the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Gravlex Med became so polluted by Imperial mismanagement of waste that the world no longer proved suitable for habitation.

==Description==
[[File:Anx_G7.jpg|thumb|left|250px|[[Anx/Legends|Anx]] on Gravlex Med.]]
A temperate world, the surface of the planet was covered in savannas and pitch-dark [[Mountain/Legends|mountains]]. The Anx lived in caves systems, emerging to browse on the [[chiliox tree]]s of the savannas. Before contact with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]] was established, the Anx developed short-distance [[Realspace/Legends|interstellar]] travel, launching their [[Starship/Legends|spacecraft]] with giant [[Cannon/Legends|cannons]]. The escape velocity from their homeworld was low enough that the Anx could survive [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] launches in such projectiles.<ref name="UAA" />

==History==
An early spacefaring race, the Anx species had built massive cannons from which they launched spacecraft into space for short-distance [[Realspace/Legends|interstellar]] travel. Colonizing the surrounding planets in what would come to be known as [[Anx Space]], Gravlex Med became the heart of the society. As an unintended consequence of their journeying, the Anx homeworld was [[Conquest of Anx Space|invaded]] briefly by [[Shusugaunt (species)|Shusugaunt]] conquerors. Driven nearly to extinction by the invaders, the Anx eventually found salvation in their world's natural defenses. Unable to survive in the high-gravity ecosystem of Gravlex Med, the Shusugaunt were forced to abandoned their conquests and flee the world.<ref name="UAA" />

At some point between [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]] and [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]],<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] discovered the [[Anx]] species and accepted them into the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]. Quickly assimilating into Republic society and governance, the entire [[Raioballo sector/Legends|Raioballo sector]] was represented in the Republic's [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] by [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Horox Ryyder/Legends|Horox Ryyder]] during the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Chancellery]] of [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]]. Retiring in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] on the eve of civil war, Ryyder returned to Gravlex Med and was replaced in the Senate by the planet's former [[President/Legends|President]], [[Zo Howler]].

Remaining loyal to the Republic throughout the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a conflict between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], the planet was protected by the [[Ninth Army]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] and saw no action during the war.<ref name="TEGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

At the end of the war the Republic was [[Declaration of a New Order|replaced]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and life on Gravlex Med changed forever. Taking control of [[Gravlex Launchworks]], Imperial mismanagement of the hazardous wastes contained in the factories caused the near extinction of the Anx species and drove all survivors off world. As the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] erupted, Gravlex Med was controlled by Imperial forces which called themselves the [[Pentastar Alignment]] after the death of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]. In [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]] [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]] annexed the Alignment sectors and Gravlex Med and other Anx colonies fell under the control of the greater [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]].<ref name="TEA" /> While under Pellaeon's control, the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] attempted to disassemble the Imperial [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] [[Chimaera/Legends|''Chimaera'']] at the orbital shipyards. However, as the New Republic attempted to destroy the starship, insurgents of the Imperial Remnant [[Battle of Gravlex Med|recaptured]] the vessel in one of Pellaeon's last victories against the Republic.<ref name="G7" />

As the Imperial Remnant struggled to maintain a cohesive structure, the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invaded]] the galaxy and control of Gravlex Med fell to the [[Yuuzhan Vong empire]]. After the alien invaders were defeated, the Imperial Remnant took to liberating their former holdings and were able to reunify while the fledgling [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] retained control over the Core.

==Behind the scenes==
The ''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]'' refers to the world twice as "Gravlex Mex" and wrongly places it in the Mid Rim.
